question: A swimmer can swim downstream at 37 km/hr and upstream at 27 km/hr. What is the speed of the swimmer in still water?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed of swimmer in still water** = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2

Speed = (37 + 27) ÷ 2

Speed = 64 ÷ 2 = 32 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 32 km/hr.**
